item.title: Kansas Connections Academy opens enrollment for the 2026-27 school year
item.description: ELKHART – Kansas Connections Academy, a tuition-free, full-time online public school, is now enrolling students in grades K-12 for the 2026-27 school year. With more than 15 years of experience, the school offers an established education program to more than 1,300 students across Kansas.

item.title: Grit and Speed on Display at DC3 Rodeo Showcase
item.description: The Dodge City Community College (DC3) Rodeo Team took part in the second annual Winter Expo Rodeo Showcase on Saturday, Jan. 31, at the Western State Bank Expo Center, joining several regional collegiate programs for an evening that combined competition with fan engagement.

item.title: Barton County Theatre to launch High School Playwrights Festival
item.description: Barton County Community College’s Theatre Department will launch its first High School Playwrights Festival in spring 2026, offering area high school students the opportunity to write and showcase original theatrical works.

item.title: Dodge City Wrestlers Featured in Latest KWCA Rankings
item.description: As the Kansas high school wrestling season enters its final month, the Kansas Wrestling Coaches Association (KWCA) has released its latest Class 6A rankings, and several Dodge City Red Demon wrestlers are earning statewide recognition.
